notes.title: Zefyr is out NOW! Please leave a review!
notes.content:
🎉Finally, it’s here ✨ After 12 years of crazy and naïve solo dev, my game Zefyr is officially released!

👇 Get it now ! 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1344990
I’m incredibly happy, grateful, and super stressed at the same time. I truly hope you’ll enjoy it! Here’s some quick info:

1 — Please leave a positive review 
...if you enjoyed the game or course! It really helps a lot to boost visibility and reach more players.

2 — Support Bundles Available
For those who want to support the project even more, I’ve created a few bundles that you can all find on the game page:

 Zefyr Soundtrack Edition: Game + soundtrack
 Zefyr Supporter Edition: Game + soundtrack + artworks + HD in-game paintings + the very first build from 12 years ago
 All My Games: Zefyr + Slide (racing game with cute animals) + Silent Night (ride Santa’s sleigh in a chill scoring game)
 All My Games Supporter Edition: Everything above (all games/soundtracks/supporter packs)

Feel free to choose one of these instead of the base edition!

3 — Playable on Steam Deck
The game runs well on Steam Deck, even if it doesn't have the official badge yet. More details about game settings here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1344990/view/542229787451589252

4 — Follow me
If you don't want to miss anything of my future updates and upcoming games, you can:

 Follow my Steam dev page: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/oneiricworlds
 Follow me on Discord, Bluesky, Reddit, YouTube, Threads, Instagram, and more: https://linktr.ee/oneiricworlds


🙏Thank you SO much for the amazing support over the years.🙏 
Your feedback and kind messages truly kept me going.

Wishing you all the best — take care, and see you soon with updates and fixes!
Have a wonderful day (and please don’t forget to leave a review!)

Mathias, the (tired) dev

notes.title: Steam Next Fest & Spanish Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The demo and prologue of Zefyr are now available in a new language: Spanish (from Spain)! I hope it’s also relevant for Latin American players too.
Of course, the full game will also be translated, but since this part is done, I decided to push the update to Steam right away!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/0f9efc875e19bfcc30e7a1f1d10291571a6dd650.jpg
By the way, it was my dad who localized the game! He's a retired Spanish professor. I hope everything is accurate, but don’t hesitate to let me know if you spot any typos or if certain words could be improved. He speaks Spanish very well, but since he's not a gamer, some terms might be a little off. Any feedback is welcome!

It was super nice working with him—it brought back memories of my old Spanish lessons at school!

On another note, the demo will be featured in Steam Next Fest next week (October, 14th). I really hope the game will reach a much larger audience. Fingers crossed! :)

And a piece of good news to wrap up this quick post: the full game has made it onto Steam's "Most Wishlisted Games" list, which is a huge milestone for a solo, unknown dev like me. Of course, I’m near the bottom of the charts, but it should still give me a bit more visibility for the full release.

Thanks so much for your continued support! Feel free to follow my dev page on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/oneiricworlds

Have a great day, and take care.

Peace!

notes.title: Release Day! Leave a review please!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today is finally the release day of Zefyr:Prologue. 
Thanks a lot for your amazing support and patience!
As a reminder, this prologue is the first chapter of the full game "Zefyr: A Thief's Melody", on which I've been working solo for 11 years. The full game should release on Q4 2024.

I really hope you'll like it! 

As I'm a super small & totally unknown solo dev, I really need all the help I can get! If you want to support me you can:
👉 Leave a review
Even a simple one like "yes" will do the trick. The more reviews, the more visible the prologue will be steam, and hopefully it will reach more players.

👉 Wishlist the full game
Because this prologue is free, I shall pay myself only when the full game releases. So the end goal is to have more people interested in the full game. And the more wishlists, the more visible the final game will be. So, please wishlist the full game and share it to your friends: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1344990/Zefyr_A_Thiefs_Melody/

🙏 Thanks A LOT for your help 🙏

Happy gaming, take care, peace!
